frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: Prepare yourselves, travellers. Lightningfist awaits, and he won't go down without a fight.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: We're ready for whatever he throws at us. Let's bring the thunder back to Ampliforia!

frames.heading: Lightningfist
frames.body: So, the brave travellers seek to awaken the Thunderstone. But do you truly possess the rock spirit worthy of such power?

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: We'll prove our worth in the language we know best: rock music!

frames.heading: Lightningfist
frames.body: You may have the audacity to challenge me, but the Thunderstone is mine to protect. I will not relinquish its power so easily.

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: Your stubbornness won't stop us, Lightningfist. Ampliforia needs the Thunderstone to thrive once more.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: If we don't awaken the Thunderstone, the rock spirit of Ampliforia will remain dormant forever!

frames.heading: Lightningfist
frames.body: Then prove to me that you are worthy. Show me the strength of your rock spirit in battle, and perhaps I will reconsider.

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: Very well, Lightningfist. Let the music decide our fate.
